conclusion: The supported GUI workspace-host correction was sufficient for actual Japanese translation delivery without changing the requested model, region, text-only mode or voice fields. This does not establish why the old provider route rejected Chelsie or prove that the client sent that voice.
limits: Only one short audio check was performed; no forty-second main stage, other apps, additional directions, quality metrics or quota checks were run.
The helper labels the stage capture-resume-observation, but this run diagnoses endpoint configuration; it is not a capture-resume claim.
The diagnostic retained port19131; the catalog's reserved VRCLT2 port19132 was not reconfigured or validated. Full profile admission remains unchanged pending that intended-route check.
Saved configuration was read back after the app's Save/restart action, but no further OS-process restart persistence experiment was performed.
The effective server connection host, returned model identity and billing were not independently captured; route selection follows saved GUI configuration and the inspected resolver.
